items.html: And behold, the drop of whiteness is the rennet that curdles the milk, so that it congeals and becomes cheese. And likewise here: from the redness in the female, which is curdled by the drop of whiteness of the male, the fetus is formed. For this reason Bina is the one that forms the fetus. And it is the vowel Tzere, as is known. And every aspect of the flesh and blood in the fetus is made from the redness, and it is from the clarifications that are clarified from the seven kings, who reigned in the land of Edom, which are the aspect of judgments and redness; and all this is clarified in the months of the Ibur. And behold, there remain aspects that cannot be clarified because of the abundance of dross in them, and those dross go out at the time of birth, in the secret of the blood of birth. And this is the secret that the little one is called firmament after he is born; and then the turbidity of the turbid waters separates from him, etc., as mentioned.
